record_type_quote: Inferential criteria: The fraction of young married women living in a nuclear family is lower in the second time period (2015) compared to the first time period (2005) using a chi-squared test.

targets.title: Going Nuclear? Family Structure and Young Women’s Health in India, 1992-2006.
targets.evidence_quote: Data-analytic replication attempt to evaluate a claim from Allendorf_Demography_2013_Y8Yx
targets.outcome_quote: Result: This claim was not replicated. The fraction of young married women living in a nuclear family decreases from 43.98% (in 2005) to 39.74% (in 2015). And, the difference is statistically significant, Chi-squared = 38.204, and p-value=6.372e-10.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The report explicitly states nonreplication in a different survey wave.

reasoning: The assigned OSF GUID resolves to the SCORE Allendorf report by Reed, Duan, and Hong, who are included in the supplied author list. The report identifies Allendorf (2013), despite the supplied descriptive title saying 2012. It tests later-wave NFHS data rather than merely rerunning the original sample, so it is a replication.
